_readme: Comments posted on collab targets posts (rotation log). One entry per comment: date, handle, post_url, text.

comments.text: The "it gets better the more I use it" part is the real unlock. Saving every manual fix back into your style examples is what stops the same caption mistake from coming back.
Putting the hardest thing of the day in your peak-energy window is such an underrated systems move. The only downside is that the excuses disappear too 😅
Point 3 is the one people skip. Divide the paper value by the hours it really takes, and that "life-changing" equity often works out to a worse hourly rate than a calm salary.
